title: Managed Backup: immutable storage
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines immutable storage.

## Tier basis

**Immutable copy storage rate.** Immutable backup copy storage; USD per GB-month.

**Minimum charged immutable retention period.** Minimum charged immutable-copy retention; calendar days integer.

| Contract tier | Immutable copy storage rate | Minimum charged immutable retention period |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 0.029 | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 0.029 | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 0.029 | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 0.029 | 30 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 0.029 | 30 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, immutable copy storage rate is 0.029.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, immutable copy storage rate stays the same.
